text:
## Release notes draft

First release: no earlier version tag, so these notes cover the whole history.

### Features
- A `greet` command that says hello to a name.
- A `shout` command that turns your text into capitals.

### Fixes
- The greeting now ends with proper punctuation.

### Other changes
- The README describes the command-line tool.
- The project was set up.

## Unsure how to group
- c8ca792 Initial commit — put under Other changes; a first commit may hold features of its own, but its subject says nothing about them.
